Title: Data Analyst
Description: We are looking for dedicated and talented people who tackle ever-changing challenges, supplier development needs, and cross-functional collaboration with clever concepts and creativity. We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of manufacturing. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world. Why you’ll love working for Siemens! Freedom and a healthy work-life balance – Embrace our flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces. Solve the world’s most significant problems – Be part of exciting and innovative projects. Engaging, challenging, and fast-evolving environment – Work with cutting-edge technology in a global network. Description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Analyst to support data-driven decisions around subscriptions and promotional offers for a major OTT streaming business. This person builds Snowflake tables, Tableau dashboards, and reports that turn complex data into clear insights for Finance, Marketing, and Product teams. SQL, Python, and strong analytical judgment are central here. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Develop analytical and reporting database tables to facilitate subscription and promotional offers performance tracking through efficient querying of large databases. - Produce and maintain critical monthly financial reports, conducting variance analysis to resolve complex anomalies and provide clear explanations. - Build reports and Tableau dashboards summarizing pertinent metrics and equipping various stakeholders with information for decision-making. - Apply quantitative analysis on complex data to support the Insights team in efforts to understand customer behavior and impact of promotional offers. - Support revenue management strategies by modeling discount strategies and analyzing subscriber retention and LTV. - Ensure data accuracy through conscientious data collection and monitoring, development and execution of quality control processes, investigation and resolution of anomalies. - Respond to a wide variety of ad hoc requests from Finance, Marketing, Distribution, Product, etc. in a timely and accurate manner. - Work closely with other members of the Insights & Analytics team to incorporate marketing and content data creating a holistic understanding of customers and how they interact with our products. MUST HAVES - 4+ years of experience with independent project ownership for the Senior Analyst level. - Fluent/business-level English (written and verbal) is required. - College degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science , or equivalent work experience. - Daily proficiency required in SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Excel, and Python . - Demonstrated proficiency in SQL (verified via test), including hands-on experience with CTEs, window functions, and date & time functions . - Primary BI tool proficiency in Tableau to build and maintain dashboards. - Familiarity with database models, transforming raw columnar data, and loading large datasets. - Basic knowledge of statistics and/or machine learning. - Familiarity with generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, ChatGPT ) for workflow efficiency, including effective prompt engineering and awareness of data security and accuracy risks. - Strong communication skills for explaining the business implications of data analysis and visualizations. - Thrives in small fast-paced environments with high individual accountability; capable of driving priorities to the finish line independently while exercising sound judgment on when to escalate. - Must maintain substantial overlap with US Eastern Time hours (roughly 10 AM – 4 PM eastern time) . NICE TO HAVES - Previous work experience with subscription and promotional offers data analysis is a plus. - Specialized experience with AWS/S3, SageMaker, R, Airflow, and dbt. PERKS AND BENEFITS - Growth without limits : build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget - Competitive compensation : get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews - Flexibility : work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm - Meaningful, modern projects : build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands - Collaborative culture : join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized - Well-being & support : access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location

Description: Organization Overview Company Description Redzone is the #1 Connected Workforce Solution for manufacturers big and small. We work to improve efficiency in plants, provide coaching for best practices, and enable the front-line worker to improve the quality of their work and their work life by providing them with tools, processes, and collaboration tools to keep their manufacturing lines running smoothly and efficiently. This role is based in Mexico & fully remote. work authorization requiered, we do not offer visa sponsirship Job Description ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and utilized by the various business units within QAD | Redzone. This engineer joins the core platform team with three main areas of focus: building new capabilities into the platform, helping Applied AI teams at partner business units build and ship Champions correctly, and directly building Champion agents for business-unit use cases when needed. You will work in the same codebase as the Applied AI engineers you support, which keeps the enablement work practical and the platform work focused on real problems. Key Responsibilities Platform Development Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories Improve developer experience: tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers. Maintain and evolve the MCP tool server and agent infrastructure that BU teams depend on. Identify and address friction points that slow down Champion development or deployment Applied AI Enablement Support BU Applied AI engineers in building, deploying, and operating Champions correctly Review agent implementations for prompt quality, scope enforcement, auth configuration, and deployment setup Contribute to internal engineering guides and skill documentation Pair with BU engineers on first K8S manifest creation, database registration, and LaunchDarkly prompt rollout Agent Development Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents Register agents in Champion Server and configure LaunchDarkly-gated prompt rollout across environments Engineering Practices We follow trunk-based development with PR-gated merges to main. Engineers are expected to: Write tests before implementing. TDD is the expectation, not a nice-to-have. Keep PRs small and focused; use feature flags to ship partial work incrementally Follow conventional commit format (feat:, fix:, etc.) Be mindful of API and schema backward-compatibility; prefer additive changes over breaking ones Review your own diff before requesting review Qualifications Core Requirements Python: Proficient in async Python, Pydantic, type hints, and FastAPI. Experience with the Strands agent SDK or a comparable agentic framework. Testing is non-optional: candidates should be comfortable with pytest, pytest- asyncio, and DeepEval for agent-specific evaluation. We test agent behavior, not just unit logic. Prompt Engineering: Able to write and iterate on production system prompts: XML-structured, scope-enforced, with tool descriptions that guide LLM delegation reliably. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Solid understanding of MCP and hands-on experience building or consuming MCP servers. Familiarity with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is a strong plus. Agent Patterns: Familiar with multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns beyond basic ReAct: supervisor/subagent delegation, parallel tool use, handoffs, and context management across agent boundaries. Agent Evals: Able to design and run evaluation suites for agent behavior: correctness checks, scope enforcement tests, regression coverage, and systematic prompt iteration based on eval results. Docker: Comfortable authoring Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and local dev environments via docker-compose / make. PostgreSQL: Comfortable with templated INSERT/SELECT, foreign key relationships, and reading an ER diagram. Git / Semantic Versioning: Follows conventional commit format (feat:, fix:) and a PR-based trunk workflow. Nice to Have Kubernetes: Working knowledge of Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and ServiceAccounts. Able to read and adapt K8s manifests and use kubectl for basic troubleshooting. AWS: Working knowledge of ECR, EKS, IAM, and Bedrock (inference layer). OAuth2 / OIDC: Conceptual understanding of Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, token exchange, and agent auth delegation. Terraform: Beginner-level familiarity; able to make targeted changes to existing modules and interpret a plan diff. LaunchDarkly: Experience managing feature flags or AI config overrides for environment-gated rollout. Document Intelligence / OCR: AWS Textract or comparable pipeline experience for use cases involving structured document extraction. AI-Native Development We run an AI-native SDLC. AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Cursor) are part of the standard engineering workflow at every stage: planning, implementation, review, and documentation. This is not optional or supplemental; it is how we work. Candidates should be comfortable with AI-assisted development and willing to invest in getting good at it. Use Claude Code and Cursor actively across planning, implementation, and code review Know when AI output is wrong and push back on it. Help drive adoption across the team by sharing what works What This Role Is Not This is not an ML research or data science role. The platform team owns cluster networking, observability pipelines, auth configuration, and LLM routing, so deep expertise in those areas is not required. The job is building reliable software on top of that infrastructure and helping others do the same. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. Title: Associate Software Engineer
Description: Job Description Engineering Guadalajara, hybrid 6 Months Fixed Term, Transitioning to Permanent Learn to build with AI. Own what ships. Grow into a great engineer. This is the start of your career, and we want it to count. If you’re early in your software engineering journey and you want to get good fast, working in an experienced team that builds with AI, SPAN is for you. It's also your entry point into SPAN LEAP (Learn, Engineer, Apply, Progress) our structured development program built to turn early-career engineers into well-rounded, AI-ready engineers. You'll not only write code but learn to think like an engineer, breaking problems down, directing AI toward clear, testable goals, and knowing when a solution, yours or the AI's, is right. You'll ship real, live work from day one, backed by a team who've done this before, building the judgment and habits that separate the engineers who thrive from the ones who plateau. We're looking for people who think critically, stay curious, and adapt fast when things change. About SPAN LEAP This role sits inside SPAN LEAP, our 12-month track that develops early-career engineers into AI-ready software engineers through real work rather than classroom training. The program runs in two stages: Stage 1: the first 6 months are a fixed-term training and evaluation period, during which we assess fit and progress against the program’s plan. Stage 2: Engineers who are meeting expectations may then continue the remaining 6 months of LEAP with the same mentorship and structured growth, but as permanent SPAN employees - a status that continues beyond the program's completion. As a SPAN LEAP Participant, You Can Expect A structured path across core engineering skill areas: front-end, APIs, data, DevOps, testing, documentation, with AI readiness built in from day one, not bolted on afterward. A real mentorship model: a working SPAN engineer is paired with you and spends dedicated time every week guiding you on live projects, alongside pair programming and structured, group-based learning loops with the rest of your cohort. Hands-on AI engineering practice: learning to direct and orchestrate AI tools toward well-defined, testable goals, not just use them as a shortcut. What You'll Do As an associate engineer, you'll work as part of a delivery team, taking on small, well-defined pieces of work with support from senior engineers. Day to day, you'll: Write, review, reason about, and validate code for small, clearly defined features, making sure it meets our coding standards and practices. Use AI tools and help orchestrate AI agents toward well-defined, testable goals. Investigate and fix bugs with guidance from more experienced engineers. Write and run tests, and make sure coverage handles both the basic cases and the edge cases. Take part in code reviews as both an author and a reviewer, and act on the feedback you get. Help configure and maintain the automated quality gates that keep our code healthy, and understand why those standards exist. Own the quality of your output, regardless of how it was produced. What We're Looking For You don't need years of experience. You do need a real foundation, strong critical thinking, and the drive to build on both. We're looking for someone who: Has 6-12 months experience. Can read and write code in at least one programming language (Java, Python, or Golang, TypeScript preferred), and understands core software development concepts. Breaks problems down clearly and can reason about whether a solution really is correct. Is keen to work with AI coding tools, and understands that the engineer owns the result, not the tool. Is comfortable with version control, or eager to learn Git properly. Learns quickly, asks substantive questions, and treats feedback as a way to get better. Communicates clearly and works well as part of a team. Nice to have None of these are required. Any of them will help you stand out: Hands-on experience with AI development tools, such as AI coding assistants or agent-based workflows. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or personal projects we can look at. Exposure to testing, a web or mobile framework, or a cloud platform. Internship, freelance, or open-source experience. How You'll Grow Growth is built into how we work, not left to chance. As a LEAP participant, you'll follow a personal growth plan over the 12-month program with clear goals, paired with a dedicated mentor. You'll learn through pair programming with senior engineers, AI-assisted learning loops, code review, and career coaching, and we'll measure your progress against SFIA, the globally recognized skills framework we use across the company. The expectation is simple: take more on, with less supervision, as your skills and judgment develop. Performance during the first 6 months determines whether you continue in the program as a permanent SPAN employee for the remaining 6 months, with growth and SFIA-based progression continuing through the full 12-month arc - after which you remain a permanent SPAN employee with LEAP complete. About SPAN SPAN Digital is a software product and consulting company headquartered in San Francisco, with development offices in Cape Town and Guadalajara. We work across a range of industries, with particular depth in technology, digital media, and fintech. For more than 13 years we've strategized, designed, and built software for clients ranging from startups to global brands. Our Services teams work side by side with clients to design prototypes, launch production-ready services, and lead major product enhancements. Senior people take real accountability for outcomes, document what they build, and hand it off well. We're often called in for the complex work internal teams can't get to: fragile, business-critical systems; modernization that can't disrupt operations; and AI initiatives that need to move past the proof-of-concept stage. Our Product teams draw on that same vantage point to build software that helps enterprises capture and use their own knowledge and gives engineering leaders real-time visibility into the systems they run, so they can make faster, more consistent decisions. We're a global, high-performing team building smart solutions for ambitious clients. At SPAN, you'll work alongside experienced founders, tackle meaningful challenges, and keep growing personally and professionally. We balance structure with flexibility, autonomy with accountability, and learning with doing. It's not about grinding, it's about thriving. What We Offer Flexible and generous work & leave schedule Hybrid working model (the best of both worlds) Learning organization based on a reverence for expertise & craftsmanship (TechRadar Sessions, complimentary education, journals, e-Learning) Team lunches, collaboration sessions, and events Charitable community initiatives, employee awards, and recognition MacBook Pro You will love it here if You are allergic to hierarchical, bureaucratic cultures You want to work with very smart people from different backgrounds You are a voracious learner & an eager teacher of others You don't tolerate intra-office posturing or other douchebaggery How To Apply If this sounds like the start you're looking for, we'd like to hear from you. Apply directly through our careers site. SPAN is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are happy to discuss reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.

Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and contribute meaningfully to planning and review cycles alongside GTM leadership. The pace here is real. Priorities shift, timelines compress, and the ground moves under your feet — not occasionally, but constantly. We need someone who is energized by that, not worn down. You won’t wait for someone to tell you what to look at. You’ll already know. Key Responsibilities GTM Analytics & Growth Program Insights Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking performance across our partnerships channel and new growth initiatives — serving audiences from country leads to executive leadership. Analyze conversion rates, pipeline health, ramp trends, and revenue attainment across programs and segments, surfacing patterns before they become decisions that have already been made. Come with a point of view. When a program is underperforming or a trend shifts, bring an interpretation and a recommendation (not just a chart). Support quarterly and annual GTM business reviews with structured analysis: cohort breakdowns, market-level benchmarks, and forward-looking indicators. Revenue Planning & Target Analysis Contribute to GTM capacity planning and quota-setting cycles — modeling scenarios, building attainment reports, and stress-testing assumptions before plans are finalized. Maintain performance-against-target reporting for growth programs and emerging channels: track attainment, flag outliers early, and ensure data is always reconciled. Support variable compensation analysis for relevant programs — running calculations, auditing for accuracy, and partnering with Finance to ensure payouts are correct and timely. Build and maintain data structures that support reliable rolling forecasts for new and high-growth segments. AI-Driven Operations & Scale Use AI tools, including Claude and other frontier models, as active parts of your workflow: automating repetitive reporting tasks, accelerating data synthesis, and building scalable analytical programs that would otherwise require a much larger team. Identify RevOps processes that can be operationalized or significantly improved through AI, and take ownership of building those solutions, not just flagging the opportunity. Apply AI-assisted analysis to extract insights at scale from large, multi-source datasets: pipeline signals, rep activity, customer behavior, and market trends. Help establish Jeeves’s AI-first approach to RevOps as a model for how the broader GTM team operates. Data Quality & Systems Integration Share responsibility for data quality across our revenue stack (HubSpot CRM, Tableau, and financial systems), conducting audits for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Connect disparate data sources (CRM, marketing automation, financial tools, and proprietary revenue data) so that reporting on growth programs is unified and trustworthy. Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic so the team works from a shared understanding of what we’re measuring and why. Stakeholder Partnership Develop enough context on our GTM motion to contribute meaningfully in planning and pipeline review cycles alongside sales leadership, bringing data that drives decisions, not just awareness. Serve as a reliable analytical resource to the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM leadership: scope requests clearly, pull the data, and return clear answers quickly. Identify process gaps and proactively propose improvements to how we collect, manage, and act on GTM data (especially across new and growing channels). What We’re Looking For Technical & Analytical Skills Tableau mastery: able to write complex calculated fields, build multi-source dashboards, and design views for diverse audiences from reps to the C-suite. Advanced Excel and Google Sheets: complex formulas, pivot tables, and financial modeling — you reach for the right tool for the job, not just the most impressive one. Strong SQL skills: you can get to an answer independently without waiting for a data engineer to pull it for you. Data integration experience: comfortable connecting CRM, marketing automation, and financial data into unified reporting environments. Business metrics fluency: deep understanding of conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), pipeline coverage, ramp curves, revenue attainment, and customer health. Data modeling: able to design clean structures that support accurate forecasting, compensation analysis, and multi-region rollups. AI Fluency (Required, Not Optional) You actively use AI tools, Claude Copilot/Code, or equivalent, as part of your day-to-day workflow, not as a novelty. You’ve used AI to automate reporting pipelines, accelerate analysis, or build operational programs that scale beyond what a single analyst could do manually. You’re curious about where AI can go next in RevOps and you bring ideas, not just execution. Soft Skills & Ways of Working Hungry and driven: you want to build something generational, and you bring the energy and output to match. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else will hold you to. Thrives in high-velocity environments: you’re not just comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — you’re energized by them. You find a way through, not a reason to wait. High agency: you don’t wait for a ticket. You’re already thinking about what the data might be missing or what question leadership will ask next week. Sharp communicator: your outputs — whether a Slack message, a Tableau dashboard, or a business review slide — are concise, structured, and ready for a senior audience. Strong time management: you’re comfortable managing multiple live workstreams, setting expectations on timelines, and delivering reliably under pressure. Low ego and collaborative: Jeeves is building something ambitious across complex markets. You’re here to make the whole team better, not just your function. Qualifications 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, or a related GTM-adjacent role. Hands-on Tableau experience is required. You should be able to demonstrate dashboards you’ve built from scratch. Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets. Experience working with CRM data (HubSpot preferred) and connecting it to downstream reporting. Exposure to incentive compensation modeling, quota attainment reporting, or variable pay analysis is strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Science, or a related field. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is preferred. Nice to Have Experience in B2B fintech, payments, corporate banking, or expense management. Familiarity with multi-currency, multi-region revenue reporting. Experience building or improving compensation and quota-tracking systems end-to-end. Background in channel partnerships, broker networks, or indirect sales models. What We Offer Competitive salary and performance-based bonus. The chance to work on analytically complex problems across 3+ continents and multiple currencies — at a company moving fast enough that your work actually changes things. A lean team that uses AI first, moves with urgency, and trusts you to own your domain from day one. Direct exposure to senior RevOps and GTM leadership. A culture that values output, curiosity, and honest feedback over hierarchy — and that genuinely believes it’s building something that matters. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: SENIOR FP&A ANALYST
Description: Descripción de la Empresa Brother es un proveedor líder de equipos para el hogar y la oficina, productos de costura y manualidades, así como soluciones industriales. Con más de 115 años de historia, nuestra marca es reconocida mundialmente por la fabricación de impresoras, máquinas de coser, rotuladoras P-touch y otros productos galardonados internacionalmente. Brother México fue establecida en 1992 y cuenta con más de 30 años de operaciones en el país. Nuestra oficina corporativa se encuentra en la Ciudad de México y es una subsidiaria de propiedad total de Brother International Corporation (BIC), con sede en Estados Unidos. A su vez, BIC forma parte de Brother Industries, Ltd. (BIL), empresa fundada en 1908 en Nagoya, Japón, con presencia en más de 30 países alrededor del mundo. ¿Por qué trabajar en Brother? En Brother México estamos orgullosos de fomentar un entorno laboral diverso e inclusivo, donde cada voz es escuchada y valorada. Nuestras prácticas de contratación y programas internos promueven la equidad, el respeto y el sentido de pertenencia en todos los niveles de la organización. Estamos comprometidos con una cultura basada en nuestros valores fundamentales: inclusión, colaboración, enfoque en el cliente y responsabilidad social. También promovemos el bienestar y la flexibilidad laboral a través de beneficios como: Esquema híbrido de trabajo, incluyendo medio día de home office los viernes. Código de vestimenta casual. Días adicionales de descanso durante el año. Programas de capacitación y desarrollo profesional. Acceso a recursos de aprendizaje autodirigido para impulsar el crecimiento continuo. Descripción General del Puesto Supervisor/a de Planeación y Análisis Financiero (FP&A) El reto Buscamos un/a Supervisor/a de FP&A que quiera ir más allá de la preparación tradicional de reportes y convertirse en un verdadero Finance Business Partner para la organización. Esta posición tendrá un papel clave en la evolución de FP&A hacia un modelo más analítico, ágil, automatizado y orientado a la generación de valor , conectando resultados financieros con operación, estrategia, rentabilidad y generación de efectivo. Tu misión será transformar datos en información accionable que permita entender: Principales Responsabilidades Participar activamente en los procesos de presupuesto anual, forecast y planeación de mediano plazo . Analizar resultados reales vs. Budget, Forecast y año anterior, identificando variaciones, tendencias, riesgos y oportunidades. Desarrollar análisis de rentabilidad, márgenes, gastos, capital de trabajo y generación de efectivo . Construir escenarios y análisis de sensibilidad que permitan anticipar posibles resultados y mejorar la toma de decisiones. Trabajar como Finance Business Partner de Sales, Marketing, Operations y otras áreas, aportando perspectiva financiera a decisiones comerciales y operativas. Desarrollar business cases y evaluar iniciativas relacionadas con crecimiento, pricing, inversiones, eficiencias y asignación de recursos. Preparar reportes y presentaciones ejecutivas, convirtiendo información compleja en mensajes claros y recomendaciones accionables. Impulsar la simplificación, estandarización y automatización de procesos dentro de FP&A. Crear y evolucionar dashboards y soluciones analíticas en Power BI . Promover información financiera confiable, consistente y trazable, trabajando con diferentes áreas para fortalecer la calidad de los datos. Analizar tendencias de ventas, inventarios, compras, canales, promociones, descuentos y desempeño comercial. Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas metodologías, herramientas y formas de trabajo dentro de FP&A. ¿Qué buscamos? Licenciatura en Finanzas, Economía, Administración, Contabilidad, Ingeniería o carrera relacionada. Al menos 5 años de experiencia en FP&A, Finanzas Corporativas, Finanzas Comerciales, Business Finance o posiciones similares. Sólida capacidad de análisis financiero , interpretación de estados financieros y análisis de variaciones. Experiencia en Budget, Forecast, análisis de escenarios y Management Reporting . Excel avanzado y experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP. Power BI requerido o altamente deseable . Conocimientos de SQL, automatización, analytics, arquitectura de datos y/o think-cell serán valorados. Inglés avanzado , con capacidad para desenvolverse en un entorno corporativo internacional. El perfil que buscamos Más que alguien enfocado únicamente en generar reportes, buscamos una persona con: Visión de negocio: capacidad para conectar decisiones comerciales y operativas con sus resultados financieros. Pensamiento analítico y curiosidad: interés por investigar causas raíz, conectar variables y cuestionar los datos. Orientación a resultados: enfoque en análisis que generen decisiones y acciones concretas. Capacidad para desafiar constructivamente: cuestionar supuestos utilizando datos y criterio financiero, manteniendo relaciones colaborativas. Comunicación ejecutiva: habilidad para simplificar temas complejos y convertirlos en mensajes claros y accionables. Proactividad y ownership: anticipar necesidades, proponer mejoras y asumir responsabilidad de principio a fin. Mentalidad de transformación: comodidad trabajando en un entorno donde procesos, herramientas y formas de trabajo están evolucionando. Perspectiva integral: capacidad para conectar P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, operación y estrategia. ¿Cómo se verá el éxito en esta posición? Esperamos que esta posición contribuya a: Mejorar la precisión y oportunidad de Forecasts, Budgets y reportes. Anticipar riesgos y oportunidades mediante mejores insights financieros. Incrementar el impacto de FP&A en las decisiones del negocio. Reducir actividades manuales mediante automatización y estandarización. Mejorar la calidad y adopción de dashboards y herramientas de gestión. Fortalecer la relación entre Finanzas y las diferentes áreas del negocio. Generar mayor visibilidad sobre rentabilidad, cash flow y principales drivers de desempeño. ¿Por qué Brother? En Brother México buscamos crear un entorno donde las personas puedan colaborar, desarrollarse y generar impacto. Ofrecemos un esquema de trabajo híbrido, oportunidades de capacitación y desarrollo, recursos de aprendizaje, beneficios enfocados en bienestar y familia, seguros y programas de ahorro, entre otros. Si te interesa evolucionar de un rol financiero principalmente transaccional hacia una posición con mayor exposición al negocio, análisis, tecnología e influencia en la toma Nuestra Misión, Visión, y cultura Nuestra misión es cumplir nuestra promesa “At your side” para simplificar y enriquecer la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades. Aspiramos a estar donde las personas y la tecnología se encuentran, ofreciendo productos y soluciones que mejoren la forma en que las personas viven, trabajan y crean. Nos guiamos por nuestros impulsores estratégicos de cultura — responsabilidad, autenticidad, audacia y excelencia — que nos permiten cumplir de manera constante con nuestra visión, misión y valores compartidos. Estos impulsores nos ayudan a construir una cultura que fortalece al negocio para alcanzar el éxito. Sobre Nuestro Entorno de Trabajo La sede de Brother México se encuentra en la Ciudad de México, en el distrito de Santa Fe. Muchas de nuestras colaboradores y funciones están ubicados en esta oficina. El edificio cuenta con una pre-certificación nivel Platino, lo que refleja nuestro compromiso compartido con la responsabilidad social en la forma en que trabajamos.
